sections.title: Fekete István and the Berek
sections.content: Fekete István (1900–1970) wrote *Tüskevár* (1957). In the novel, Tutajos and Bütyök spend a summer in the Berek, the marshland of the Kis-Balaton, with Matula bácsi. The reading is an original text about the writer's view of nature.

sections.title: What you know: adjectives in -s
sections.content: You know adjectives in *-s/-os/-es/-ös* from A2 Unit 4. Two new words use the pattern: *körforgásos* (circular) and *vizes* (wet): `vizes élőhely` (wetland), `körforgásos gazdaság` (circular economy).

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A természetben minden anyag körbe jár.
In nature every material goes round in a circle.
A vizes élőhely sok állatnak ad otthont.
A wetland is home to many animals.
A körforgásos gazdaság újra használja az anyagokat.
The circular economy uses materials again.
